exposure: Continuous-wave Doppler ultrasound (Umbiflow) screening for placental insufficiency (raised resistance indices (RIs) of the umbilical artery, absent end-diastolic flow (AEDF))
cohort: Pregnant women classified as having low-risk pregnancies, attending antenatal clinics in Mamelodi township, east of Pretoria, SA.
finding: The perinatal mortality rate in the Umbiflow screened group (11.4/1 000 births) was significantly lower than in the unscreened group (21.3/1 000 births), suggesting that screening a low-risk pregnant population with continuous-wave Doppler ultrasound can reduce unexplained stillbirths and perinatal deaths.
cross-section timing: Screening performed between 28 and 32 weeks' gestation
gest_age: N/A (screening performed between 28 and 32 weeks' gestation)
